title: Erik Satie - Gymnopédie No.1
summary: A recording of Erik Satie's Gymnopedie No. 1, one of the best-known pieces of minimalist piano music by the French composer.
why: Recommended as an accessible entry to Satie and calm ambient classical music, and mentioned as a famous influence on game soundtracks.

quote.text: perhaps putting a name to it will give you some appreciation for why his work is valued
